description: This PHP source file defines the Currency controller class for the OpenCart admin task system, handling currency-related tasks such as generating currency lists, clearing currency files, and managing currency tasks for different stores and languages.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency tasks in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of currency tasks for all stores and languages, including clearing old data and scheduling currency list tasks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file with currency data for a specific store and language, returning success or error messages.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated currency JSON files for all stores and languages.
